name: Muscat
tagline: Arabian Elegance, Desert Mountains, and Genuine Hospitality
description: Muscat is the Middle East's best-kept secret — a strikingly beautiful capital wedged between the Hajar Mountains and the Arabian Sea, offering a unique blend of traditional Omani culture and modern comfort. Unlike flashier Gulf neighbors, Muscat is understated, safe, and genuinely welcoming to foreigners. The cost of living is moderate by Gulf standards, there is no income tax, healthcare is good, and the natural surroundings — from dramatic wadis to pristine beaches — are spectacular. English is widely understood, making daily life accessible for Western expats.

quickFacts.visa: 10-day visa on arrival or e-visa for US citizens. Investor residency available with property purchase ($260K+). Retirement visa pilot program launched — requires proof of income and health insurance. Tourist visa renewals possible.
quickFacts.safetyRating: Very High – one of the safest countries in the world
quickFacts.climate: Hot desert with extremely hot summers and pleasant winters

housing.description: Modest 1BR in Al Khuwair / Bausher / Ruwi

dining.description: Local Omani/Indian eats, home cooking in between

transportation.description: Used car (essential; minimal transit) + cheap petrol

1M.lifestyle: A frugal but easy Muscat rhythm — a modest 1-bedroom in Al Khuwair or Bausher and a used car, which is essential given the city's minimal public transit. Meals at local Omani and Indian spots with home cooking in between, and a basic private plan. The beaches, wadis, and mountain drives are free and spectacular. Summer heat pushes air-conditioning costs up from May to September, and no income tax helps the budget stretch.

housing.description: 2BR apartment in Qurum, Al Mouj, or a villa flat in Shatti Al Qurum near the beach

dining.description: Regular dining at international restaurants, beach club lunches, traditional Omani feasts

healthcare.description: Comprehensive private insurance with access to modern hospitals and specialists

transportation.description: Reliable mid-range SUV for wadi and desert exploration; essential for lifestyle

entertainment.description: Diving in Daymaniyat Islands, desert camping, golf, beach club membership, cultural events

2M.lifestyle: A comfortable step up — a nicer 1- or 2-bedroom in Qurum or Shatti Al Qurum, a mid-range car for wadi and desert trips, and dining out regularly at good international restaurants. Comprehensive private health cover. Weekend diving and desert camping fit easily, with room for regular regional travel.

housing.description: Nice 2BR in Shatti/Qurum or a 1BR in Al Mouj

dining.description: Regular hotel restaurants (The Chedi / Al Bustan) + mid-range

3M.lifestyle: A comfortable Muscat life with real margin — a nice apartment in Shatti or Qurum, or a place in Al Mouj near the marina, an SUV for off-road adventures, and regular dining at hotel restaurants like The Chedi and Al Bustan Palace. Premium individual health cover with international access. Golf, diving trips, and weekend escapes to Jebel Akhdar are all comfortably within budget.

housing.description: Luxury villa in Al Mouj with marina access, or a premium beachfront property in Qantab

dining.description: Regular fine dining at 5-star hotels, private chef for entertaining, exclusive food experiences

healthcare.description: VIP concierge medical service with international hospital network and evacuation coverage

transportation.description: Multiple luxury vehicles (Range Rover, Porsche), driver available, premium insurance

entertainment.description: Exclusive golf and yacht club, private diving charters, luxury desert expeditions, cultural patronage

domesticHelp.description: Full-time housekeeper, cook, gardener, and pool maintenance; live-in staff common in Oman

luxuryExtras.description: First-class international travel, luxury Oman resort stays, yacht charters, philanthropy

5M.lifestyle: An upscale Muscat lifestyle — a luxury villa or marina apartment in Al Mouj, near-daily fine dining, and household help. A luxury car, top health cover, and a generous budget for golf, boating, and social life. Oman's safety, natural beauty, and moderate Gulf costs make this a high quality of life with meaningful margin.

housing.description: Waterfront villa in Al Mouj / private compound toward Qantab–Yiti

domesticHelp.description: Full staff (maid + cook/driver/gardener), salary + food/visa overhead

10M.lifestyle: The top of Muscat living — a waterfront villa in Al Mouj or a private compound toward Qantab or Yiti, full household staff, and international, evacuation-grade health cover. Multiple vehicles, frequent fine dining, and boating along the coast toward Musandam. Muscat's moderate costs and small luxury market cap how much can be spent without waste, so this is a lavish coastal life that still leaves a wide margin.
